milestones.description: Uses position_near_with_facing because this is a find/locate task where the player must navigate to a specific object in the scene. The crafting table is at spawn-relative (8, 1, 5) inside a jungle shelter ~9.4 blocks from spawn. max_distance=4 requires the player to actually walk close to it (not just turn at spawn), and facing_tolerance=60 ensures they are looking at the crafting table, confirming they have found it.

Uses inventory_has because crafting jungle_stairs produces items that end up in the player's inventory. The player starts with 6 jungle_planks and 0 jungle_stairs; the recipe yields 4 jungle_stairs from 6 planks on a 3x3 grid. Any jungle_stairs in inventory must have been crafted at the crafting table, so min_count=1 is sufficient to confirm task completion with no false positives.
